principles_under_test: theory-only Markdown with no inline MCQ
TOC, links and See also integrity

evals.prompt: Создай новый чит-шит по Spring Boot Actuator и подготовь его для quiz-app.
evals.expected_output: A new parser-compatible Russian theory file, a synchronized JSON MCQ sidecar, valid links and registry updates.

assertions.name: correct-surface
assertions.check: Creates theory under cheatsheets/interview/** and MCQ under seed/mcq/**; does not create legacy SQLite options.

assertions.name: valid-frontmatter
assertions.check: Markdown starts with valid YAML frontmatter matching the repository metadata contract.

assertions.name: parser-compatible
assertions.check: Every question heading uses canonical `## Q<N>.` syntax; no duplicate IDs.

assertions.name: new-file-numbering
assertions.check: New topic starts at Q1 and uses sequential IDs.

assertions.name: no-inline-mcq
assertions.check: Markdown contains no `> [!mcq]` blocks.

assertions.name: russian-readability
assertions.check: Answers are natural Russian, concise, engineer-to-engineer; APIs and configuration keys use backticks.

assertions.name: coverage-plan
assertions.check: Covers endpoint exposure, health groups, probes, metrics/Micrometer, security, custom indicators/endpoints, operations and common traps without padding.

assertions.name: primary-sources
assertions.check: Useful links prioritize official Spring Boot and Micrometer documentation; no fabricated incidents.

assertions.name: examples
assertions.check: Contains relevant Java/YAML examples and at least one comparison or operational diagnostic section where useful.

assertions.name: important-markers
assertions.check: Roughly 20-30% of genuinely high-signal questions use `(!)` without forcing exact arithmetic.

assertions.name: toc-sync
assertions.check: `## Содержание` matches actual question headings and includes See also.

assertions.name: see-also
assertions.check: Top-level `## See also` is at the end and contains useful valid relative Markdown links.

assertions.name: json-sidecar
assertions.check: JSON topic_slug and q_numbers match the Markdown; testable questions have schema-valid MCQ.

assertions.name: mcq-handoff
assertions.check: JSON options follow mcq-quality-fixer and golden-examples, including parity and one defensible answer.

assertions.name: validation
assertions.check: Reports frontmatter/parser/link checks plus verify-mcq-json and answer-parity results.

assertions.name: registries
assertions.check: Updates TOC.md and any required counters only if repository conventions require them.

evals.prompt: Улучши файл cap-theorem-interview.md, добавь недостающие вопросы и сделай ответы глубже, не ломая существующие ссылки.
evals.expected_output: An expanded, research-backed CAP theory file with stable existing IDs, appended questions and synchronized JSON.

assertions.name: reads-before-write
assertions.check: Reads the complete Markdown and parallel JSON before editing.

assertions.name: preserve-existing-ids
assertions.check: Existing Q identifiers are not renumbered; new questions are appended after the maximum ID.

assertions.name: preserve-content
assertions.check: Does not delete useful original answers merely to rewrite style.

assertions.name: research-quality
assertions.check: Uses primary/authoritative sources and distinguishes network partition, availability and consistency precisely.

assertions.name: depth
assertions.check: Adds meaningful coverage such as PACELC, quorum trade-offs, linearizability vs eventual consistency, failure assumptions and practical database behavior.

assertions.name: no-padding
assertions.check: New questions are not near-duplicates and each tests a distinct interview-relevant concept.

assertions.name: readability
assertions.check: Long walls are split; comparisons use tables; examples clarify trade-offs.

assertions.name: no-inline-mcq
assertions.check: No inline MCQ blocks are added or preserved.

assertions.name: toc-updated
assertions.check: Local TOC reflects all added questions without broken anchors.

assertions.name: see-also-valid
assertions.check: See also remains a top-level final section with valid relative links.

assertions.name: json-sync
assertions.check: Adds matching q_number entries for new testable questions and updates only semantically affected existing entries.

assertions.name: validation
assertions.check: Reports parser, duplicate-ID, link, q-number sync and JSON gate results.

evals.prompt: Добавь в sql-interview.md вопросы про индексы: B-tree, hash, составные, covering, partial, selectivity и причины, почему индекс может не использоваться.
evals.expected_output: New index-focused theory questions appended with SQL examples and matching JSON MCQ.

assertions.name: stable-ids
assertions.check: Existing IDs are preserved and new IDs are appended after the highest current Q.

assertions.name: scope
assertions.check: Questions focus on indexing and do not duplicate existing SQL basics.

assertions.name: database-context
assertions.check: Provider-specific behavior is labeled, especially PostgreSQL-specific index semantics.

assertions.name: index-coverage
assertions.check: Covers B-tree, hash, composite prefix/order, covering/include, partial indexes, selectivity and planner non-use cases.

assertions.name: sql-examples
assertions.check: Includes realistic `CREATE INDEX` and `EXPLAIN` examples with correct SQL fences.

assertions.name: tradeoffs
assertions.check: Explains write amplification, storage, maintenance, statistics and query-shape trade-offs.

assertions.name: russian-readability
assertions.check: Natural Russian, short paragraphs, terms in backticks, no textbook filler.

assertions.name: no-inline-mcq
assertions.check: Markdown contains no inline MCQ blocks.

assertions.name: toc-and-links
assertions.check: TOC and See also are updated and relative links resolve.

assertions.name: json-sync
assertions.check: Every new testable Q has a matching schema-valid JSON entry.

assertions.name: mcq-quality
assertions.check: Options are delegated to mcq-quality-fixer and pass visual/structural parity checks.

assertions.name: validation
assertions.check: Runs Markdown and JSON validators and reports exact results.

evals.prompt: Сделай текст java-functional-interface-interview.md проще и естественнее на русском, не меняя факты и состав вопросов.
evals.expected_output: A readability-only refactor with stable IDs and no unnecessary JSON changes.

assertions.name: mode-selection
assertions.check: Classifies the task as READABILITY_REFACTOR, not semantic rewrite.

assertions.name: stable-question-set
assertions.check: No Q is added, deleted or renumbered.

assertions.name: semantic-preservation
assertions.check: Definitions, API signatures, guarantees and examples retain the same meaning.

assertions.name: natural-russian
assertions.check: Removes bureaucratic and machine-translated phrasing; improves paragraphing and punctuation.

assertions.name: no-template-overcorrection
assertions.check: Does not force every answer into identical headings or length.

assertions.name: json-unchanged
assertions.check: Parallel JSON remains unchanged unless an actual semantic inconsistency is discovered and explicitly reported.

assertions.name: no-inline-mcq
assertions.check: Does not introduce inline MCQ.

assertions.name: validation
assertions.check: Runs parser/heading/TOC/link checks and reports that JSON sync was not required.

evals.prompt: Исправь в hibernate-relationships-interview.md устаревшее или неточное объяснение LAZY/EAGER и синхронизируй тесты.
evals.expected_output: A researched semantic correction in theory and the affected JSON block only.

assertions.name: mode-selection
assertions.check: Classifies the task as SEMANTIC_UPDATE.

assertions.name: primary-research
assertions.check: Checks Jakarta Persistence/Hibernate primary documentation and states provider/version nuances.

assertions.name: precise-claim
assertions.check: Does not reduce LAZY/EAGER to guaranteed JOIN vs separate SELECT; distinguishes contract from provider query strategy.

assertions.name: bounded-edit
assertions.check: Changes only affected question(s), examples and links; avoids whole-file churn.

assertions.name: stable-ids
assertions.check: Preserves q_number identifiers.

assertions.name: json-sync
assertions.check: Updates matching JSON question_text/options/sections only where meaning changed.

assertions.name: golden-mcq
assertions.check: Affected options follow golden examples and cannot be guessed by visual form.

assertions.name: fact-freshness
assertions.check: Updates freshness metadata when repository policy requires it.

assertions.name: validation
assertions.check: Runs verify-mcq-json, answer-parity and any structure/stamp gates required by mcq-quality-fixer.

evals.prompt: Удали Q12 из topic-interview.md как дубликат Q7 и приведи всё в порядок.
evals.expected_output: A safe question lifecycle change that removes only Q12, preserves other IDs and updates all references and JSON.

assertions.name: reference-search
assertions.check: Searches Markdown, JSON and registries for inbound references to Q12 before deletion.

assertions.name: no-renumber
assertions.check: Q13 and later keep their existing IDs; the gap is not closed automatically.

assertions.name: duplicate-proof
assertions.check: Confirms Q12 is actually redundant before removing it.

assertions.name: json-remove
assertions.check: Removes only q_number 12 from the parallel JSON.

assertions.name: link-repair
assertions.check: Redirects meaningful references to Q7 or reports unresolved references.

assertions.name: toc-update
assertions.check: Removes Q12 from local TOC without changing unrelated entries.

assertions.name: validation
assertions.check: Runs duplicate-ID, q-number sync, link and JSON checks.

assertions.name: atomicity
assertions.check: Leaves Markdown, JSON and references in one coherent state.

evals.prompt: Переименуй topic-interview.md в better-topic-interview.md и обнови все зависимости.
evals.expected_output: An atomic topic rename across Markdown, JSON, topic_slug, links, registries and freshness sidecars.

assertions.name: pre-rename-search
assertions.check: Searches the repository for old basename/title references first.

assertions.name: markdown-rename
assertions.check: Renames the Markdown file and updates frontmatter title/aliases only where needed.

assertions.name: json-rename
assertions.check: Renames the parallel JSON and updates topic_slug.

assertions.name: inbound-links
assertions.check: Updates relative Markdown links and JSON related references.

assertions.name: registries
assertions.check: Updates TOC.md, README.md and other discovered registries.

assertions.name: sidecars
assertions.check: Renames or updates fact-freshness and topic-specific sidecars when present.

assertions.name: old-name-clean
assertions.check: A final repository search finds no unintended stale old-name references.

assertions.name: validation
assertions.check: Runs parser, links, q-number sync and JSON schema/parity checks.

evals.prompt: Проведи аудит kafka-interview.md и скажи, что нужно улучшить. Ничего не меняй.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-based audit report with severity and no file modifications.

assertions.name: audit-only-mode
assertions.check: Selects AUDIT_ONLY and does not modify files.

assertions.name: complete-read
assertions.check: Reads the complete Markdown and parallel JSON.

assertions.name: parser-audit
assertions.check: Checks frontmatter, headings, duplicate IDs, TOC, See also and inline MCQ ban.

assertions.name: content-audit
assertions.check: Identifies shallow, outdated, duplicated or missing Kafka topics with concrete Q IDs.

assertions.name: sync-audit
assertions.check: Checks Markdown/JSON q_number and semantic consistency.

assertions.name: readability-audit
assertions.check: Flags walls of text, poor tables/examples and cognitive overload.

assertions.name: severity
assertions.check: Classifies findings as CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW.

assertions.name: no-writes
assertions.check: git diff remains unchanged.

evals.prompt: Удали legacy inline MCQ из spring-transactions-interview.md, но не потеряй вопросы и обучающую ценность.
evals.expected_output: Inline MCQ is removed only after its useful coverage is represented in the JSON sidecar.

assertions.name: inventory-inline-blocks
assertions.check: Finds every `> [!mcq]` block and maps it to its Q number.

assertions.name: json-first
assertions.check: Checks whether equivalent JSON MCQ exists before removing each block.

assertions.name: migration-no-loss
assertions.check: Migrates missing unique misconceptions or coverage through mcq-quality-fixer.

assertions.name: theory-preserved
assertions.check: Does not delete surrounding answer theory or examples.

assertions.name: no-inline-remains
assertions.check: Final Markdown has zero inline MCQ blocks.

assertions.name: json-valid
assertions.check: Parallel JSON remains schema-valid with one correct option per block.

assertions.name: parity
assertions.check: Migrated options follow golden examples and parity gates.

assertions.name: validation
assertions.check: Reports inline-ban, q-number sync and JSON validation results.

evals.prompt: Добавь новый вопрос про поведение API, но не трогай варианты ответов — они уже есть в JSON.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the lifecycle contradiction and avoids creating a dangling or mismatched question.

assertions.name: detects-contradiction
assertions.check: Recognizes that a new Q requires a matching q_number; existing JSON options cannot be assumed to map automatically.

assertions.name: no-dangling-q
assertions.check: Does not add a Markdown question without determining its stable q_number and JSON mapping.

assertions.name: bounded-sync
assertions.check: Reuses an existing matching JSON entry only when its semantics and q_number are proven identical; otherwise requests or performs mcq-quality-fixer sync.

assertions.name: no-inline-mcq
assertions.check: Does not solve the contradiction by adding inline options.

assertions.name: transparent-report
assertions.check: Explains the synchronization decision and any blocker.
